duas.title: After eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it without any power or strength from me.

duas.title: Before sleeping
duas.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: After waking up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

duas.title: Entering the toilet
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.

duas.title: Entering the masjid
duas.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

duas.title: Leaving the masjid
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.

duas.title: After wudu
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh.
duas.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

duas.title: When leaving home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor strength except through Allah.

duas.title: When entering home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

duas.title: For forgiveness
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa tub 'alayya innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepter of repentance, the Most Merciful.

duas.title: For parents
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.

duas.title: For good in both worlds
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

categories.description: Duas for cleanliness, wudu, and masjid.

categories.title: Forgiveness
categories.description: Duas asking Allah for forgiveness and mercy.
